title: Dependent-Parent Additions Restored with Disability Compensation
content:
The parent additions in a restoration of Disability Compensation are as many parent additions as the parent maximum of 2 when the award records at least 2 dependent parents, one parent addition when it records exactly one dependent parent, and nothing when it records none. Dependent parents recorded are the parent additions on the award less the parent removals, counted for every month a restoration covers.

A restoration month priced from the 100 percent tier takes the parent addition of 176.88 for each parent counted; every other restoration month takes the award's own tier.

| Parents recorded | Additions per month at Disability Compensation (50% Combined Rating), veteran-alone month (hypothetical) |
|---|---|
| None | Nothing |
| 1 | 88.44 |
| 2 | 176.88 |
| 4 additions, 1 removal (3 recorded) | 176.88 (the maximum of 2) |
